import Mathlib

def Continua (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x, |x - a| < δ → |f x - f a| < ε

example (a : ℝ) : Continua (fun x => 3 * x + 1) a := by
  intro ε hε
  refine ⟨ε / 3, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  dsimp only
  rw [show 3 * x + 1 - (3 * a + 1) = 3 * (x - a) by ring, abs_mul]
  norm_num
  linarith
